name: Florian Atlas
source:
Zodiac: Scorpio

Professor Atlas is MC's handsome and beloved college professor...
...but lying underneath that gentlemanly smile lies a wolf in sheep's clothing.

Likes: history books, conspiracy theories, fitted suits, cologne and coffee. 
Dislikes: the scorching heat of the desert, the demon mosquitos in the thick jungles, the terror zone of the department's storage closet and students who sleep in his class. 

Fun Fact: His most prized possession is his coffee maker.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/love-spell-written-in-the-stars]official website[/url]]
